_about: Remaps from codes MEDSL uses to the county FIPS codes in the us-atlas map. Loaded by president.ts. Each entry says why. States with no county results at all are listed in packages/shared/data/no-county-layer.json.

46113.why: Shannon County, SD was renamed Oglala Lakota County in 2015 and given a new code.

51515.why: Bedford city, VA merged into Bedford County in 2013.

2938000.why: Kansas City, MO reports separately from Jackson County; its votes are cast in Jackson County, and the map has no separate Kansas City shape.
